display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-25 Advanced TSO control rooms to enhance grid observability, stability and resilience – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-25 Advanced TSO control rooms to enhance grid observability, stability and resilience
executive_summary: Designs and pilots vendor-agnostic transmission control rooms for real-time monitoring, forecasting, congestion management and coordination with adjacent network operators. Eligible consortium beneficiaries can receive up to 70% for for-profit beneficiaries under Horizon Europe. The indicative topic budget is EUR 28.5 million, with around EUR 9.5 million expected per project. Opening 2027-08-04, full proposal deadline 2027-12-01 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Work Programme Part 8, pp. 174–176, Scope and Specific conditions, funds this work, which connects to National Facility Digital Twin of the Electricity System. The topic expects at least two electricity TSOs and two universities or research organisations. TenneT can be a funded Dutch TSO consortium member under Annex B, subject to the China-control restriction. The funded consortium role supports Type 1 and C1.3. The helper supplied both project dates from 1 January 2027 using its 36-month default.
